Function P(o As Object,k As String) As String
Dim v As Variant
On Error GoTo Failed
v=CallByName(o,k,VbGet)
If IsNull(v) Then
P="Null(1)"
ElseIf IsEmpty(v) Then
P="Empty(0)"
Else
P=CStr(v) & "(" & VarType(v) & ")"
End If
Exit Function
Failed:
P="ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number)
End Function
Function RuleRange(f As Object) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
RuleRange=f.AppliesTo.Address
Exit Function
Failed:
RuleRange="ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number)
End Function
Function Held(f As Object) As String
Held="class=" & TypeName(f) & ";p=" & P(f,"Priority") & ";applies=" & RuleRange(f) & ";f1=" & P(f,"Formula1") & ";bold=" & P(f.Font,"Bold")
End Function
Function Snapshot() As String
Dim ws As Worksheet,f As Object,c As Range,k As Variant,s As String
For Each ws In ActiveWorkbook.Worksheets
s=s & "SHEET[" & ws.Name & "]count=" & CStr(ws.Cells.FormatConditions.Count)
For Each f In ws.Cells.FormatConditions
s=s & "|RULE[class=" & TypeName(f) & ";applies=" & RuleRange(f)
For Each k In Array("Type","Priority","StopIfTrue","Formula1","Formula2","Operator","Rank","Percent","TopBottom","AboveBelow","NumStdDev","DupeUnique","Text","TextOperator","DateOperator")
s=s & ";" & CStr(k) & "=" & P(f,CStr(k))
Next
s=s & ";bold=" & P(f.Font,"Bold") & ";italic=" & P(f.Font,"Italic") & ";fill=" & P(f.Interior,"Color") & ";bottom=" & P(f.Borders(xlBottom),"Color") & ";nf=" & P(f,"NumberFormat") & "]"
Next
s=s & "|CELLS["
For Each c In ws.Range("A1:L10").Cells
s=s & c.Address(False,False) & ":" & P(c.DisplayFormat.Font,"Bold") & "," & P(c.DisplayFormat.Interior,"Color") & "," & c.Text & ";"
Next
s=s & "]"
Next
Snapshot=s
End Function
Function ParentRange(o As Object) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
ParentRange=o.AppliesTo.Parent.Name & "!" & o.AppliesTo.Address
Exit Function
Failed:
ParentRange="ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number)
End Function
Function OneProxy(o As Object) As String
Dim s As String
s="class=" & TypeName(o)
s=s & ";parent=" & ParentRange(o)
s=s & ";priority=" & P(o,"Priority")
s=s & ";dupe=" & P(o,"DupeUnique")
s=s & ";rank=" & P(o,"Rank")
s=s & ";bottom=" & P(o.Borders(xlBottom),"Color")
s=s & ";bottomIndex=" & P(o.Borders(xlBottom),"ColorIndex")
OneProxy=s
End Function
Function Observe(label As String,src As Object,cp As Object,f As Object,g As Object,cf As Object,cg As Object,h As Object,ch As Object) As String
Dim s As String,rf As Object,rg As Object,rh As Object
s=label & "[activeBefore=" & ActiveSheet.Name
s=s & "|originalHeldF{" & OneProxy(f) & "}"
s=s & "|originalHeldG{" & OneProxy(g) & "}"
s=s & "|copiedHeldF{" & OneProxy(cf) & "}"
s=s & "|copiedHeldG{" & OneProxy(cg) & "}"
Set rf=cp.Range("A1").FormatConditions(1)
Set rg=cp.Range("B1").FormatConditions(1)
s=s & "|copiedFreshF{" & OneProxy(rf) & "}"
s=s & "|copiedFreshG{" & OneProxy(rg) & "}"
If Not h Is Nothing Then
s=s & "|newHeldH{" & OneProxy(h) & "}"
s=s & "|newRetrievedH{" & OneProxy(ch) & "}"
Set rh=cp.Range("C1").FormatConditions(1)
s=s & "|newFreshH{" & OneProxy(rh) & "}"
End If
s=s & "|activeAfter=" & ActiveSheet.Name & "]"
Observe=s
End Function
Function EnumerateOnly(ws As Object) As String
Dim o As Object,s As String
s="enumerate[" & ws.Name & ";activeBefore=" & ActiveSheet.Name
For Each o In ws.Cells.FormatConditions
s=s & "|rule{" & OneProxy(o) & "}"
Next
s=s & "|activeAfter=" & ActiveSheet.Name & "]"
EnumerateOnly=s
End Function
Function ProxyProbe() As String
Dim src As Object,cp As Object,f As Object,g As Object,gone As Object,cf As Object,cg As Object,h As Object,ch As Object,s As String,v As String
Set src=ActiveSheet
src.Name="Original"
Set f=src.Range("A1:A3").FormatConditions.AddTop10
f.Rank=2
f.Borders(xlBottom).Color=vbRed
Set g=src.Range("B1:B3").FormatConditions.AddUniqueValues
g.DupeUnique=xlUnique
g.Borders(xlBottom).Color=vbBlue
src.Copy After:=src
Set cp=ActiveSheet
cp.Name="Copied"
s="copyReturnedActive=" & ActiveSheet.Name
Set cf=cp.Range("A1").FormatConditions(1)
Set cg=cp.Range("B1").FormatConditions(1)
cp.Activate
s=s & "|" & Observe("beforeH-copyActive",src,cp,f,g,cf,cg,h,ch)
src.Activate
s=s & "|" & Observe("beforeH-originalActive",src,cp,f,g,cf,cg,h,ch)
cp.Activate
Set h=cp.Range("C1:C3").FormatConditions.AddTop10
h.Rank=3
h.Borders(xlBottom).Color=vbGreen
Set ch=cp.Range("C1").FormatConditions(1)
s=s & "|" & Observe("afterH-copyActive",src,cp,f,g,cf,cg,h,ch)
src.Activate
s=s & "|" & Observe("afterH-originalActive",src,cp,f,g,cf,cg,h,ch)
cp.Activate
s=s & "|" & EnumerateOnly(cp)
s=s & "|" & Observe("afterCopyEnumeration-copyActive",src,cp,f,g,cf,cg,h,ch)
s=s & "|" & EnumerateOnly(src)
s=s & "|" & Observe("afterOriginalEnumeration-copyActive",src,cp,f,g,cf,cg,h,ch)
s=s & "|snapshotActiveBefore=" & ActiveSheet.Name
v=Snapshot()
s=s & "|snapshot{" & v & "}"
s=s & "|snapshotActiveAfter=" & ActiveSheet.Name
cp.Activate
s=s & "|" & Observe("afterSnapshot-copyActive",src,cp,f,g,cf,cg,h,ch)
src.Activate
s=s & "|" & Observe("afterSnapshot-originalActive",src,cp,f,g,cf,cg,h,ch)
ProxyProbe=s
End Function

End If
s=s & "|activeAfter=" & ActiveSheet.Name & "]"
Observe=s
End Function
Function EnumerateOnly(ws As Object) As String
Dim o As Object,s As String
s="enumerate[" & ws.Name & ";activeBefore=" & ActiveSheet.Name
For Each o In ws.Cells.FormatConditions
s=s & "|rule{" & OneProxy(o) & "}"
Next
s=s & "|activeAfter=" & ActiveSheet.Name & "]"
EnumerateOnly=s
End Function
Function ProxyProbe() As String
Dim src As Object,cp As Object,f As Object,g As Object,gone As Object,cf As Object,cg As Object,h As Object,ch As Object,s As String,v As String
Set src=ActiveSheet
src.Name="Original"
Set f=src.Range("A1:A3").FormatConditions.AddTop10
f.Rank=2
f.Borders(xlBottom).Color=vbRed
Set g=src.Range("B1:B3").FormatConditions.AddUniqueValues
g.DupeUnique=xlUnique
g.Borders(xlBottom).Color=vbBlue
Set gone=src.Range("J1:J3").FormatConditions.AddTop10
gone.Delete
src.Copy After:=src
Set cp=ActiveSheet
cp.Name="Copied"
s="copyReturnedActive=" & ActiveSheet.Name
s=s & "|initialSnapshotActiveBefore=" & ActiveSheet.Name
v=Snapshot()
s=s & "|initialSnapshot{" & v & "}"
s=s & "|initialSnapshotActiveAfter=" & ActiveSheet.Name
Set cf=cp.Range("A1").FormatConditions(1)
Set cg=cp.Range("B1").FormatConditions(1)
cp.Activate
s=s & "|" & Observe("beforeH-copyActive",src,cp,f,g,cf,cg,h,ch)
src.Activate
s=s & "|" & Observe("beforeH-originalActive",src,cp,f,g,cf,cg,h,ch)
cp.Activate
Set h=cp.Range("C1:C3").FormatConditions.AddTop10
h.Rank=3
h.Borders(xlBottom).Color=vbGreen
Set ch=cp.Range("C1").FormatConditions(1)
s=s & "|" & Observe("afterH-copyActive",src,cp,f,g,cf,cg,h,ch)
src.Activate
s=s & "|" & Observe("afterH-originalActive",src,cp,f,g,cf,cg,h,ch)
cp.Activate
s=s & "|" & EnumerateOnly(cp)
s=s & "|" & Observe("afterCopyEnumeration-copyActive",src,cp,f,g,cf,cg,h,ch)
s=s & "|" & EnumerateOnly(src)
s=s & "|" & Observe("afterOriginalEnumeration-copyActive",src,cp,f,g,cf,cg,h,ch)
s=s & "|snapshotActiveBefore=" & ActiveSheet.Name
v=Snapshot()
s=s & "|snapshot{" & v & "}"
s=s & "|snapshotActiveAfter=" & ActiveSheet.Name
cp.Activate
s=s & "|" & Observe("afterSnapshot-copyActive",src,cp,f,g,cf,cg,h,ch)
src.Activate
s=s & "|" & Observe("afterSnapshot-originalActive",src,cp,f,g,cf,cg,h,ch)
ProxyProbe=s
End Function
